dogecoin.text: @General_Oluchi Here's what I do with Dogecoin, when I sense the hype, I hop in with an amount I can afford to lose, make some extra dollars and jump out before the hype dies down 😁

@General_Oluchi I doubt Elon owns a single doge coin. Don't be deceived by his posts and jokes about the coin. Doge is a joke and a hype coin with no fundamentals or enticing projects for now or even the future. No sensible hodler or trader would risk so much on dogecoin.
